description: Java class providing image transformation services, including reading images, scaling images based on properties, parsing XML configurations, and converting images to BufferedImage.

classes.name: ImageTransform
classes.description: Provides static methods for image processing tasks such as reading, scaling, XML parsing, and conversion to BufferedImage.

methods.name: getBufferedImage
methods.description: Reads an image from a file location and returns a map with the BufferedImage and response message.

methods.name: scaleImage
methods.description: Scales a BufferedImage according to specified dimensions and returns the scaled image along with scale factor.

methods.name: getXMLValue
methods.description: Parses an XML file to extract configuration values into a map.

methods.name: toBufferedImage
methods.description: Converts an Image object to a BufferedImage.
